kill: Two rules: (i) a scheme passes the full adversary grammar yet loses byte-exact recall on the held-out adversary grammar — the certification claim dies; (ii) red-teaming cost per cut exceeds 100× the cut cost at 10× scale — Y2 dies as an online mechanism (survives only as offline certification). Held-out grammar authored by a separate crew, preregistered BEFORE Y2's battery.
mechanism: Deterministic read-only red-team proposes worst-case segmentations (pathological cuts, permuted IDs) from a fixed preregistered adversary grammar; recall answers probes from the corrupted-but-legal segmentation; failures are negative evidence, revisable by organ 5.
name: Adversarial chunking
